components.name: /Missions Folder Name
components.description: The actual folder name in the /Missions directory. This should match the physical folder name to ensure relative links work correctly. If the folder name differs from the mission name in the database, update this value accordingly.

components.name: Card Image URL
components.description: Full-width banner image at the top of this mission's landing page card. Supports absolute URLs, mission-relative paths (e.g., 'banner.png' for Missions/[mission]/banner.png), and public assets (e.g., 'public/images/logos/logo.png'). Leave blank to use the card color gradient.

components.name: Card Color
components.description: Shown as a gradient banner when no card image is set. Leave blank for a neutral default.

components.name: Card Subtext
components.description: Short line shown under the mission title on the landing page card. Leave blank to omit.

components.name: Archived
components.description: When checked, this mission is listed under 'Archived Missions' on the landing page instead of 'Active Missions'.
